verdict.rationale: Convertio is a cloud file-conversion SaaS with an API, CLI and official wrappers, so it could plausibly publish an official MCP server and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The API, CLI and wrappers are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
